pages.title: Cryo Fuel
pages.text: A crystalline fuel source created by infusing coal with $(l:threats/hollow)Hollow$(/l) Frozen Breath. Burns in Thermal Heaters for $(bold)4x longer than coal$() (96,000 ticks vs. 24,000).$(br2)Yes, you are burning frozen ghost breath to heat your base. Yes, ORSA Thermodynamics Division has written 14 memos about why this shouldn't work. Yes, it works anyway.$(br2)$(italic)"The energy density of Cryo Fuel exceeds theoretical models by a factor of four. Recommend immediate investigation." — Dr. Vasik$(br)$(italic)"The investigation budget was redirected to evacuation shuttles." — ORSA Finance$()
Frozen Breath over Coal. One ghost encounter fuels your heaters for hours. ORSA calls this a "risk-reward loop." Survivors call it "Tuesday."
